name: montage
description: Example planners: assemble a spine from handles, or drop sound cues on composition events.

assemble.description: Append one spine clip per handle, each `clip_ms` long (clamped to the asset).

clip_ms.description: Timeline length taken from the head of each asset.

event_sfx.description: Place an ln_sfx cue on every composition event named `event`.

event.description: Composition event name to listen for.

drop_asset.description: Audio handle placed at each hit.
